<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. VI.|ACCORDING TO S. MATTHEW.|15}}</noinclude>{{verse|chapter=6|verse=5}}† And when ye {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ THE SEcond worke of iustice.}}∷ pray, you shal not be as the {{sup|‖}} hypocrites, that loue to stand & pray in the Synagogs and corners of the streetes, that they may be seen of men: Amen I say to you, they haue receiued their revvard. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=6}}† But thou vvhen thou shalt pray, enter into thy chamber, & hauing shut the doore, pray to thy father in secrete: and thy father vvhich seeth in secrete, vvil repay thee. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=7}}† And vvhen you are praying, speake not much, as the heathen. For they thinke that in their {{sup|‖}} much-speaking they may be heard. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=8}}† Be not you therefore like to them, for your father knovveth vvhat is needeful for you, before you aske him.

{{verse|chapter=6|verse=9}}† Thus therefore shal you pray. {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 11, 2.''}}* {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ The PATER NOSTER.}}∷ ''{{sc|Ovr father}} which art in heauen, sanctified be thy name''. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=10}}† ''Let thy Kingdom come. Thy wil be done, as in heauen, in earth also''. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=11}}† ''Giue vs to day our '' {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ In S. Luke, the Latin is, ''Panem quotidianum, dayly bread'', the Greeke being indifferent to both, ''τὸν ἐπιούσιον''.}}∷ ''{{sup|‖}} supersubstantial bread''. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=12}}† ''And forgiue vs our {{sup|‖}} dettes, as we also forgiue our detters''. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=13}}† ''And {{sup|‖}} leade vs not into tentation. But deliuer vs from euil. Amen''. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=14}}† For {{sup|‖}} if you vvil {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mr. 11, 25.''}}* forgiue men their offenses, your heauenly father vvil forgiue you also your offenses. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=15}}† But if you vvil not forgiue men, neither vvil your father forgiue you your offenses.

{{verse|chapter=6|verse=16}}† And vvhen you {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ The third worke of iustice.}}∷ {{sup|‖}} fast, be not as the hypocrites, sad. For they disfigure their faces, that they may appeare vnto men to fast. Amen I say to you, that they haue receiued their revvard. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=17}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō Ashwensday.}}But thou vvhen thou doest fast, anoynte thy head, and wash thy face: {{verse|chapter=6|verse=18}}† that thou appeare not to men to fast, but to thy father vvhich is in secrete: and thy father vvhich seeth in secrete, vvil repay thee.

{{verse|chapter=6|verse=19}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 12, 33.''}}* Heape not vp to your selues treasures on the earth: vvhere the rust & mothe do corrupt, & vvhere theeues digge through & steale. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=20}}† But heape vp to your selues {{sup|‖}} treasures in heauen: vvhere neither the rust nor mothe doth corrupt, and vvhere theeues do not digge through nor steale. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=21}}† For vvhere thy treasure is, there is thy hart also.⊣ {{verse|chapter=6|verse=22}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 11, 34.''}}* The candel of thy body is thine eye. If thine eye be simple, thy vvhole body shal be lightsome. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=23}}† But if thine eye be naught: thy vvhole body shal be darkesome. If then the light that is in thee, be darkenes: the darkenes it self hovv great shal it be?

{{verse|chapter=6|verse=24}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel on the 14 Sunday after Pentecost.}}No man can {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 16, 13.''}}* serue {{sup|‖}} tvvo masters. For either he vvil hate the one, and loue the other: or he vvil sustayne the one, and contemne the other. You cannot serue God and Mammon.

{{verse|chapter=6|verse=25}}† Therfore I say to you, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 12, 22.''}}* be not {{sup|‖}} careful for your life vvhat you shal eate, neither for your body vvhat rayment you shal<noinclude>{{rh|||put}}</noinclude>
